doses.rationale: Estimated peak and average free concentrations exceed the cellular IC50, but the estimated trough does not. The verdict therefore depends on the concentration metric. The protocol also contradicts its planned dose levels by stating that every participant receives 200 mg.

Estimated peak and average coverage exceed the cellular IC50, whereas trough coverage does not. The estimate assumes exposure scales linearly from 960 mg, despite reported non-dose-proportional sotorasib PK.
All three estimated metrics exceed the cellular IC50, but trough coverage is marginal and sensitive to the assumed IC50, half-life, and dose–exposure relationship.
Estimated peak, average, and trough free concentrations exceed the assumed cellular IC50. Trough coverage remains model-dependent.
Estimated peak, average, and trough free concentrations exceed the assumed cellular IC50. Trough is inferred from a simple elimination model, not measured trough PK.
